[TPS_MANI_03327] Network Interface configuration for DoIP ⌈The DoIpNetworkConfigurationDesign contains all configuration settings that are specific for a configured network connection. The network connection is configured with the PlatformModuleEthernetEndpointConfiguration that is referenced by the DoIpNetworkConfigurationDesign in the role networkConfiguration. The tcpPort and udpPort references to the ApApplicationEndpoint are used to configure the T ransport Protocol (Udp or Tcp) and the used Port number. The IP Address is configured in the NetworkEndpoint that is referenced by the PlatformModuleEthernetEndpointConfiguration via the EthernetCommunicationConnector.⌋
